_doc: Point-in-time retrospective. Every input was public on as_of; see sources. Hindsight lives only in outcome.json.
methodology: house v2 (EPP-distance adjustment), 6-section format; retro method r2: scenario inputs derived from dated facts by frozen rules (retro/README.md); semiconductor signals with NVIDIA's rule-T thresholds; the listing rule (NVDA listed 1999-01-22)

pit_profile.why: 'NVIDIA is a visual computing company, connecting people through the powerful medium of computer graphics.' 'The market for our products is intensely competitive and is characterized by rapid technological change, evolving industry standards and declining average selling prices.' 'We expect substantial competition from both Intel's and AMD's strategy of selling platform solutions, including integrating a CPU and a GPU on the same chip or same package, as evidenced by AMD's APU product and Intel's CPUs with integrated graphics.' 'Our business is cyclical in nature and has experienced severe downturns that have harmed, and may in the future harm, our business and financial results.' (FY2013 10-K); CYCLICAL on the 10-K's own words for its business (BKR's 'Our business is cyclical' reading); no theme in taxonomy_eras.json covers a CPU and a GPU integrated on one chip, so those words stay here (the PEP obesity rule)

BEAR.desc: EPS -4.3%/yr (worst year FY04-FY13 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, capped at 0%); P/E to its 10th pct

BASE.desc: EPS -7.2%/yr (Q4 FY14 guide YoY + margin + buyback); P/E at its 10-yr ex-FY09 ex-FY10 median

BULL.desc: EPS +29.2%/yr (FY04-FY13 ex-FY09 ex-FY10 CAGR, at least BASE); P/E holds its 75th pct

XBULL.desc: EPS +147.2%/yr (best 2-yr run FY04-FY13 ex-FY09 ex-FY10, at least BULL); P/E at its 90th pct

summary: NVDA (retrospective, 2014-02-07) ◉ BUY — Ratio B 0.17x (25.7% downside to Bear $11.79 / +155.2% upside to Bull $40.50) | Adj composite 2.06 vs market 1.60: gap +0.46 [MODESTLY UNDERVALUED] | +26% above the EPP floor $12.60 (14x FY14E $0.90) | Conservative 2-yr case: +12.2% total (+6.1%/yr) | At 17.6x FY14E the 15% hurdle price $20.99 sits between the BASE and BULL cases; revenue -12.5% YoY in Q3 FY14, forward revenues -7% to -3.2% (Q4 FY14 revenue guide (Q3 FY14 CFO commentary)); no disruption theme has dated evidence.
